recipe.notes:
The T4 four-phase (text) and ViDoRe (visual) judge. Client block from the scenarios: no temperature is sent, max_output_tokens 16384, context_tokens 131072 (the scenario engine --max-model-len; the checkpoint's own mpe is 262 144), decoding json_schema, image_processor qwen3_vl, max_images 10. The visual run's slot used concurrency 128; the recipe carries the catalog's 256 and the slot value is runtime tuning (open question 4). Serving: --reasoning-parser qwen3, --max-model-len 131072, limit_mm_per_prompt {"image": 10}. No --kv-cache-dtype for either variant: the paper set none and the NVFP4 checkpoint's kv_cache_quant_algo is null, so both serve BF16 KV. Memory arithmetic, both GPU classes (GiB, --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 default). Both variants share the KV shape: 12 full-attention layers x 2 x 2 KV heads x 256 head_dim x 2 B = 24 576 B/token across ranks; the linear-attention recurrent state is 36 layers x 48 value heads x 128 x 128 x 4 B ~113 MB/sequence. - NVFP4 (132.7 GB on disk, 11 shards): B200 (192 GB; 0.92 -> 176.6 GB) TP1 -> 132.7 GB weights, ~44 GB cache;
  KV at TP1 24 576 B/token -> a full-length 131 072-token sequence ~3.0 GiB -> ~14 full-length sequences (or
  thousands of 2k windows). H100 (80 GB; 0.92 -> 73.6 GB): TP1 does not fit (132.7 > 73.6); TP2 -> 66.4 GB
  weights, ~7 GB cache; KV at TP2 (the 2 KV heads replicate x2, so 12 288 B/token/GPU) ~1.5 GiB per
  full-length sequence -> ~4 sequences: serve with `--set resources.gpus=2`. Native FP4 GEMM wants SM100; on
  Hopper vLLM falls back to Marlin W4A16 with a warning.
- FP8 (185.5 GB on disk, 131 shards): B200 TP2 -> 92.8 GB weights/GPU, ~84 GB cache; KV at TP2 12 288
  B/token/GPU -> ~50 full-length sequences. H100: TP2 does not fit (92.8 > 73.6); TP4 -> 46.4 GB weights/GPU,
  ~27 GB cache; KV at TP4 (1 KV head/GPU) 12 288 B/token/GPU -> ~18 sequences: serve with
  `--set resources.gpus=4`.
At the text run's concurrency 256 the linear-attention states cost ~7.2 GB/GPU at TP4 and ~3.6 GB at TP2. History: the scenarios served the NVFP4 candidate at TP4 (and the FP8 fallback at TP4); the decision-41 shapes are the per-variant resources above. Engine support: Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration is in vLLM v0.31.0's registry (registry.py:601-604, module qwen4_exp); both pins were checked 2026-10-09. status: unverified until the E2 judge wave passes.

The scenarios' candidate. `--quantization modelopt_fp4` is declared (auto-detection would map the checkpoint's NVFP4 quant_algo to the same method) and the checkpoint excludes its linear-attention, hyper-connection, gate, embed and lm_head modules from quantisation. B200: TP1 (resources.gpus 1); H100: `--set resources.gpus=2` (the family note's arithmetic).
